summary: Frontend-only test of new admin 'Import Data' feature (Impor Keluarga & Impor Kader). Admin login (admin/admin123) works. Sidebar nav 'admin-nav-import' navigates to import-data-page which renders both cards with 4-item Panduan lists, disabled upload buttons initially, and functional Excel template downloads (template_keluarga.xlsx 6199B, template_kader.xlsx 6092B) with 'Template diunduh' toast. Full upload flow tested end-to-end: uploaded valid+invalid xlsx files, upload buttons enabled after file selection, result panels rendered with green success count (2 keluarga / 1 kader) and amber 'Baris yang gagal' list showing per-row error messages ('Baris 4: nama_kk dan kelurahan wajib diisi', 'Baris 3: nama dan username wajib diisi'). All QA IMPORT test data was cleaned up via API after test.
critical_code_review_comments: ImportData.js: hardcoded axios responseType blob + Blob([res.data]) works but Content-Disposition filename from server is ignored (uses local templateName) — acceptable.
Success toast text 'X data berhasil diimpor' uses res.data.created but does not surface partial-failure count; that info is visible in the inline result panel so it's fine.
Console shows recharts warnings 'width(-1)/height(-1) of chart should be greater than 0' on dashboard mount — cosmetic, pre-existing (not part of this feature).
seed_data_creation: Created 2 QA IMPORT keluarga and 1 qa_kader_<ts> via import; all deleted via DELETE /api/keluarga/{id} and /api/admin/kader/{id} after test.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Kader list endpoint for admin is GET/DELETE /api/admin/kader (not /api/kader which 404s). Login returns 'access_token' field. Token stored client-side in localStorage 'pws_token'. Import Data feature is fully working end-to-end (download + upload + result panel + toast).
